expected_cells: LEFT / TOP: one simple low rounded pale tan ordinary hat, broad soft brim, one plain warm-brown band; delicate contour and broad watercolor wash. No buckle, detailed felt, sharp crown creases or wearer.

RIGHT / BOTTOM: one quiet watercolor map impression with broad muted sage landforms and pale blue water. No terrain partitions, folds, text, grid, political borders or route; avoid fine cartographic detail.
required_state_direction_contact: Two wide horizontal bands, TOP hat and BOTTOM map, each independent and complete. These are pictures INSIDE future thought clouds, not real props added to the story. Keep all painted contours comfortably inside their cell with clean key-colour separation. No thought frame, trail, people, scenery, furniture or text. The hat is the adults’ mistaken reading, not a replacement for canonical Drawing One. The map is a visual aid for mental geography, not an asserted flight route.
light: Soft neutral upper-left illumination; opaque pale interiors, restrained luminous watercolor.
